fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.2 preserves the mirror-only OCum model and owner-authored live visibility, but replaces the ineffective add-only remote overlay rebuild with RaceMenu's targeted RevertOverlay current-skin path. Each owner-visible Body [OvlN] on the STR proxy is rebound to the proxy's current body/skin with resetDiffuse=false, preserving the OCum texture while fixing stale overlay geometry across OStim body/scene transitions. Local OCum rendering, PPA, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
